printerSetting.agentArrangeEmpty: No print stations or printers to arrange yet
printerSetting.agentArrangeHint: Drag ⋮⋮ to reorder print stations; drag a printer to reorder it within its print station. Only changes how the map looks on this device
printerSetting.agentAutoRestartOff: Auto restart after reboot: Permission needed (tap to allow)
printerSetting.agentAutoRestartPermission: To let the print station restart by itself after a reboot or being closed, allow "Display over other apps" for this app
printerSetting.agentBoundElsewhere: This device is the print station of another store. Turn on here to move the print station to this store.
printerSetting.agentEntryOff: Automatically prints through a print station when direct printing fails · tap to view
printerSetting.agentEntryOn: This device is a print station · tap to view the connection map
printerSetting.agentForgetHint: Removes it from the list on this device only (with its built-in printer). It shows up again when the print station comes back online
printerSetting.agentJobErrBusy: Printer is busy (another device is printing)
printerSetting.agentJobErrNoContent: The print job has no content
printerSetting.agentJobErrNotReady: Printer not responding (powered off, offline or out of paper)
printerSetting.agentJobErrOtherNetwork: Printer is on another network, the print station cannot reach it
printerSetting.agentJobErrSend: Failed to send the job to the printer
printerSetting.agentJobErrUnreachable: Could not reach the printer when sending (powered off, offline or wrong IP)
printerSetting.agentJobLogEmpty: No print jobs have been sent to this device yet
printerSetting.agentLeaveChangeCompany: Switching company pauses printing for the current store. The print station turns back on when you return to this store.
printerSetting.agentLeaveLogout: Logging out pauses printing for the store. The print station turns back on when you log in to this store again.
printerSetting.agentLeaveTitle: This device is a print station
printerSetting.agentMapAgent: This device is a print station — printers it manages

printerSetting.agentNoAgentHint: No print station is online. When a printer fails, the app prints through a print station if the company has one
printerSetting.agentOtherAppIsAgent: Another app build on this device (@app) is already the print station. Turn it off there first, then turn it on here
printerSetting.agentOthersTitle: Other print stations in the company (@count)
printerSetting.agentPeerMore: @count more printers (older print station version reports only some)
printerSetting.agentPeerNoPrinters: This print station has not reported any printer
printerSetting.agentPeerOfflineHint: This print station is off — printer status below is as of @time
printerSetting.agentPeerOldVersion: @agent runs an older app version, so its printers cannot be turned on / off remotely. Update EasyPOS on that print station (or tap the printer on the print station itself).
printerSetting.agentReconnectBuiltIn: Could not connect the built-in printer. Try restarting the device
printerSetting.agentReconnectBusy: The printer is busy or held by another device. Wait for it to finish, then retry
printerSetting.agentReconnectMoved: The printer's IP changed @oldIp → @newIp. Updated and reconnected
printerSetting.agentReconnectNotFound: Printer not found on the network. Check it is on and its network cable / Wi-Fi is connected
printerSetting.agentReconnectNotFoundNoMac: Could not reach the printer. Check it is on, cabled, and its IP is still correct
printerSetting.agentReconnectOtherNet: The printer is on another network. Switch this device to the printer's Wi-Fi
printerSetting.agentReconnectOtherWifi: The printer is on Wi-Fi "@wifi"; this device is on another network
printerSetting.agentReconnectStepMac: Searching the printer by MAC address (its IP may have changed)
printerSetting.agentReconnectUsb: USB printer not found. Re-plug the USB cable and retry
printerSetting.agentRemoveConfirm: Turn off print station mode on @agent? It will stop printing for other devices
printerSetting.agentRemoveFailed: Could not send the request — check the network
printerSetting.agentRemoveHint: This print station has no printers. Removing turns off print station mode on that device (it double-checks and ignores the request if it has printers)
printerSetting.agentStoppedRemotely: Print station mode on this device was turned off remotely (@by) because it has no printers
printerSetting.agentSwitchNetworkHint: This device cannot reach the printers below. Switch to the printer's Wi-Fi to print
printerSetting.agentWifiPickInPanel: Pick "@wifi" in the Wi-Fi panel, then come back
printerSetting.agentWifiPrinterOff: This device is already on this Wi-Fi — the printer may be off or offline
printerSetting.agentWifiUnknownHint: Never printed from this device, so the printer's Wi-Fi is unknown
printerSetting.printStationHint: Devices on another Wi-Fi or on mobile data print through this print station. It must be on the printer's network (or connected to the printer by USB) with the app open
printerSetting.printStationToggle: Use this device as a print station
printerSetting.printStationUnavailable: Could not turn on the print station, check the internet connection and try again
printerSetting.printStationWaiting: Waiting for print jobs from other devices
printerSetting.relayHeld: @printerName is out of paper / cover open. The print station is holding the ticket and will print it when the printer is ready — no need to print again.
printerSetting.relayNoStation: No print station is online for this company. Turn on "Use this device as a print station" on a device on the printer network first
printerSetting.remotePrintFailed: The print station could not print to @printerName
printerSetting.remotePrintTimeout: The print station did not respond, check that it has the app open and internet access
printerSetting.stationBuiltInSkipped: @printer is offline (its print station is off) — skipped for now, other printers still print
printerSetting.wifiSwitchFailed: Could not switch to Wi-Fi "@wifi". Check the password and that the Wi-Fi is in range
